name: hud_ui_mgr_sensor_place_track_counter_widget
description: HudUiMgrSensor::PlaceTrackCounterWidget allocates the next sensor marker slot, projects a tracked world point to screen space, places the slot with replicate-mode scaling, and positions the edge counter widget for off-screen projections.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x412070 validates the 32-entry capacity guard, target marker count increment, zMath::ProjectPointAndClampToScreenClip call into the slot screen coordinate fields, replicate-mode doubling before the virtual SetPos dispatch, screen-edge switch branches, slot screenEdgeCode/trackNode stores, and return 1 only for the in-bounds projection branch.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x412070 has known stack-pointer warnings around the shared virtual SetPos dispatch in the case-2/4/8 edge branches, but the surrounding assembly and direct callee contracts are accepted; all source dependencies are accepted in the functional lane.

The native smoke covers the full capacity return, an in-bounds projection that stores the slot position and tracked node, and a replicated left-edge projection that assigns the counter image, makes the counter widget visible, doubles the slot position, and clamps the counter widget to the sensor viewport top band.
